adminOutreach.strictOn: Outreach is off: the strict rule applies in this hub.

noticeTimings.within_days: Within a set number of days

purposes.rfq_invitation_notice: Notice of a request for quotes

autonomy.manual: Manual: a person approves every batch
autonomy.assisted: Assisted: the assistant drafts, a person approves

engine_floor.name: Engine floor
engine_floor.pass: No consumer, automated or forbidden channel.
engine_floor.fail: The message would break the engine floor.
engine_floor.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

policy_mode.name: Hub policy mode
policy_mode.pass: The active policy allows outreach here.
policy_mode.fail: The strict rule applies: nobody is contacted.
policy_mode.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

pack_rule.name: Country pack rule
pack_rule.pass: The recipient's and the hub's jurisdictions allow it.
pack_rule.fail: A country pack rule forbids it or says nothing.
pack_rule.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

hub_rule.name: Hub rule
hub_rule.pass: The hub has a rule for this class and channel.
hub_rule.fail: The hub has no rule for this class and channel.
hub_rule.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

source_use.name: Source allows contact
source_use.pass: The data source lists outreach as an allowed use.
source_use.fail: The data source does not allow contact.
source_use.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.fail: Suppressed by an objection, unsubscribe or registry.
suppression.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

screening.name: Screening
screening.fail: Screening is unavailable or not clear; the gate fails closed.
screening.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

touch_cap.name: Touch limit
touch_cap.pass: Within the touches allowed per recipient and purpose.
touch_cap.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

sender_checks.name: Sender checks
sender_checks.fail: A sender check does not pass yet.
sender_checks.wait: Checked when the dry run reaches it.

floor.title: Engine floor
floor.consentOnly: Only with the person's recorded prior consent
floor.maxTouches: Most touches per recipient and purpose
floor.optOutValue: One-click unsubscribe and a "stop" reply, always
floor.note: These are fixed rules of the engine, not settings: no hub policy can lower them.

overview.title: Outreach
overview.lede: Contact with companies that are not participants yet: the policy, campaigns, replies and suppression.
overview.killSwitchHelp: Stops every outreach step at the next boundary and cancels queued messages. Releasing it needs a second person.

policies.title: Outreach policies
policies.lede: Policy versions per jurisdiction, the country pack facts they rely on and the engine floor.
policies.secondPersonValue: A different staff member approves activation
policies.volumeValue: {perDay} a day per hub, {perDomain} a week per recipient domain, {touches} touches per purpose, {days} days apart
policies.counselRequired: A counsel approval record is required before this mode can be activated.
policies.modeHelp: A draft changes nothing. A mode other than strict activates only with a counsel approval record and a second person.
policies.simulateHelp: Shows what each version would decide for one recipient. Nothing is sent or stored.
policies.recipientJurisdictionHelp: ISO code, for example US-CA. Unknown means no contact.
policies.noPackFacts: The hub's country pack has no outreach facts yet.
policies.packNote: Facts stay unverified until counsel review; an unverified fact never opens outreach on its own.

decisions.strict_mode: No contact: the strict rule applies.
decisions.unknown_jurisdiction: No contact: the recipient's jurisdiction is unknown.
decisions.unknown_recipient_class: No contact: the recipient class is unknown.
decisions.engine_floor: No contact: the engine floor forbids it.
decisions.no_rule: No contact: no rule covers this class and channel.
decisions.prohibited: No contact: a rule prohibits it.
decisions.consent_missing: No contact: the person's recorded consent is missing.
decisions.source_disallows: No contact: the data source does not allow it.
decisions.suppressed: No contact: the recipient is suppressed.

campaigns.title: Outreach campaigns
campaigns.lede: Each campaign shows its gates and the exact message per language and jurisdiction before anyone approves it.
campaigns.channelHelp: Automated calls, texts, messenger, contact forms and social messages are not offered: the engine floor excludes them.
campaigns.detailLede: Gates, the exact messages and the run state of this campaign.
campaigns.firstVersion: The first version of a campaign always needs a person to activate it.
campaigns.autoPaused: Paused automatically: {rule} on {date}. A person resumes it with a note.
campaigns.dryRun: Dry run on {date}: gates were checked and nothing was sent.
campaigns.previewsHelp: Each message as it would be sent, per language and jurisdiction. Locked blocks are written by the engine.

templates.title: Outreach templates
templates.lede: Templates per purpose and language. Only the body is editable; the engine writes the locked blocks.
templates.bodyHelp: Saved as a new version; the locked blocks stay as they are.

replies.title: Replies and hand-off
replies.lede: Replies sorted by class. Objections are applied automatically; questions wait for a person, who answers in the company's thread.
replies.untrusted: Reply text is untrusted: it cannot start any action.
replies.rehearsal: These replies come from a staff rehearsal with synthetic inboxes; no real recipient was contacted.
replies.handoff: A claim asked for in words never starts a claim: the answer points to the claim form.
replies.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# reply waits} other {# replies wait}} for a person.

suppression.title: Suppression and objections
suppression.lede: Counts by reason and scope, one exact lookup at a time and the registries polled.
suppression.noBrowse: Look up one address at a time; the list cannot be browsed.
suppression.identifierHelp: Exact match only. The lookup is recorded in the audit log.
suppression.privacyOnly: Only the privacy officer can look up an identifier.
suppression.audited: This lookup was recorded in the audit log.
suppression.notFound: No suppression for this exact identifier.

deliverability.title: Outreach deliverability
deliverability.lede: The outreach sender, its DNS checks, the ramp and the rates against the thresholds. Counts only, never per person.
deliverability.separateIdentity: Outreach uses its own sending domain, so complaints never affect transactional mail.
deliverability.thresholdsValue: Complaints: warning above {warn} %, pause above {pause} %. Hard bounces: pause above {bounce} %.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle journeys
lifecycle.lede: Messages to participants and partners who chose to receive them: steps, limits and how many are enrolled.
lifecycle.capValue: {count, plural, one {# message a month} other {# messages a month}}
lifecycle.noPeople: Journeys show counts only, never people.

errors.strict_mode: The strict rule applies: a campaign cannot be activated.
errors.counsel_required: A counsel approval record is required before this mode can be activated.
errors.sender_checks: SPF, DKIM and DMARC must all pass before a campaign can start.
errors.locale_missing: A hub language is missing: every hub language needs this template before activation.
errors.not_paused: Only a paused campaign can be resumed.
errors.already_engaged: The kill switch is already engaged.
errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.

outcomes.version: Demo: this would be saved as a new version; nothing is saved.
outcomes.second_person: Demo: this would ask a second person to approve; nothing is saved.
outcomes.dry_run: Demo: a dry run would check every gate and send nothing; nothing is saved.
outcomes.paused: Demo: this would pause it; nothing is saved.
outcomes.stopped: Demo: this would stop it and cancel queued messages; nothing is saved.
outcomes.resumed: Demo: this would resume it with your note; nothing is saved.
outcomes.engaged: Demo: this would engage the kill switch; nothing is saved.
outcomes.suppressed: Demo: this would suppress the address; nothing is saved.
outcomes.checked: Demo: this would check the DNS records again; nothing is saved.
